decision: Keep published libjxl 0.11.2 and its existing default fixed thread runner; retain only compatible JXL output-buffer reuse.
measurementNotes: Release, coverage disabled; compressed Data loaded before timing; fresh ImageSource per decode.
Five repetitions per page/configuration; three repetitions per six-page batch/concurrency; three oversized repetitions.
Configurations rotated between iterations. The reference buffer remains alive for per-page comparisons.
Every final single-page and oversized output was compared byte-for-byte with the previous rendering path.
Peak is sampled whole-process physical footprint every 5 ms; allocatedBytes is cumulative PixelBuffer storage, not peak memory or all codec allocations.

Screening records retain only regular-page cases with identical output and nominal thermal state; the broader preliminary prototype changed spread resampling and was corrected before final confirmation.
The first temporary allocation-budget test failed with 50135040 bytes versus 38338560; the final probe passes at 38338560.
Archive extraction, input loading, GPU upload and rendering in the reader UI are excluded.

verification.deviceSkip: Synthetic alpha/orientation fixture metadata unavailable through iOS 17 ImageIO; test passed on iOS 18.5.
verification.independentReview: No remaining findings after rounding and grayscale conversion regressions were addressed.
